name: Record Book: a complaint log of documented unpunished crimes
note: A documentary instrument, not a filing: no lien, no assertion of jurisdiction, no legal effect. Data-first — canonical JSON under record-book/data/, rendered to static pages, nothing written twice. Four axes are kept apart and never collapsed: act (did it occur), actor (who did it), forum (what a court did), restoration (what reached the harmed). Every figure is derived on build with its n reported; no derived count is stored. Corpus scanned: 25 complaints 1740-1981, all historical, all from published scholarship, commissions, court records and the contemporaneous press. Named respondents are recorded as whom the sources accuse, with provenance, and no living person is pronounced guilty. Nobody is conscripted into a claim by being recorded — standing defaults, and every register row carries a consent_note.

survival.duration: indefinite — the record ages slowly, but archive locators rot
survival.survives_gallery: yes — it is a document set, not an installation
survival.irl_contingency: Static pages, same-origin only: no font, no CDN, no analytics, no third-party request, zero runtime dependencies. The no-browser contingency is the data itself — record-book/data/*.json is plain JSON, and validate.mjs, interrogate.mjs and inquire.mjs are text-mode.
survival.note: 53 archive locators are verified:false and have NOT been resolved. This environment has no outbound network egress — every host returns 403 at the proxy, NARA's catalogue API included, tested rather than assumed. The same standing applies to every figure in data/precedents.json.

awaiting_owner.question: Should record-book.css link /venue.css first and drop its own palette?
awaiting_owner.detail: The venue's subtree convention says yes, with public/fleet/fleet.css as the worked example. Not done, and flagged rather than silently skipped, because the record book's ramp was verified computationally: a sequential single-hue scale, monotonic in OKLCH lightness in both light and dark, every step's ink at >=4.5 text contrast — the dark step-4 measured 4.11 and was darkened until it cleared at 5.00. Adopting the venue palette wholesale would discard that verification, and re-verifying against venue.css is the actual task. Small, but it is a design decision and not mine to make unilaterally.

awaiting_owner.detail: Raised by the venue session and recorded here rather than assumed. A merge is not the same thing as the owner having chosen to publish. Nothing in the work depends on the answer; only where it is served.
